name: Utsushikome of Fusai
source:
A serious and somewhat neurotic student with a strange sense of humor that only comes out in private. She has a familial connection to the Order through her grandfather, a former member of the Discretionary Council, and also studied under another during her arcane tutelage in Mekhi. She and Ran have an old but strange friendship, as well as a certain goal for visiting the conclave unrelated to their class. However, they haven't shared the details. She enjoys mystery novels. Her talent lies in her near-perfect memory, especially for numbers, and her mathematical and logical ability. Yet that rationality is undermined by a stubborn streak; she will break before she bends.

[Edited from in-game encyclopedia]
